swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The energy of an electron in the L-shell is greater than that of an electron in the K-shell. Reason (R): The K-shell is closer to the nucleus than the L-shell. Choose the correct option: (i) Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A. (ii) Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A. (iii) A is true, but R is false. (iv) A is false, but R is true.
